description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions for managing IPsec XFRM policies in Linux using netlink communication. It includes enums for directions and actions, structures for policy templates and policies, and functions for adding, updating, deleting, listing, and retrieving policies.

methods.name: selFromPolicy
methods.description: Populates an nl.XfrmSelector based on an XfrmPolicy object.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyAdd
methods.description: Adds a new IPsec XFRM policy to the system.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing IPsec XFRM policy.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyDel
methods.description: Deletes an IPsec XFRM policy from the system.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IPsec XFRM policies, optionally filtered by family.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyGet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPsec XFRM policy by index or selector.

methods.name: XfrmPolicyFlush
methods.description: Flushes all IPsec XFRM policies from the system.

methods.name: xfrmPolicyAddOrUpdate
methods.description: Internal method to add or update a policy with specified netlink message type.

methods.name: xfrmPolicyGetOrDelete
methods.description: Internal method to get or delete a policy based on netlink message type.

methods.name: parseXfrmPolicy
methods.description: Parses a netlink message into an XfrmPolicy object.
